# Sea wall: an unlit teal plane 18 x 6.6 m facing the camera, its top at the water line, 5 m back.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sea --base-color 0.204 0.675 0.729 --no-slot --emission 0.204 0.675 0.729
add mesh grid --name Wall --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 2 --size 1 --location 0 5 -3.3 --rotation 90 0 0
scale 18 1 6.6
apply --scale
material assign Sea
shade flat
export seawall.glb
